task.description:
RELEASE-VALIDATOR independently PASSED all six of REQ-067's acceptance criteria (result.status PARTIAL overall, but PARTIAL is about unrelated pre-existing full-suite noise, ISS-0217, not about REQ-067 itself -- its own next_action explicitly says to proceed to Step 6). Per WF-02 Step 6:

1. Flip `docs/requirements.yaml`'s REQ-067 entry `status: in_progress` -> `status: done`.
2. Append a `done` event to the CURRENT run-history volume. Read `docs/status/requirement_status.index.yaml` first to confirm the current volume (should still be v2 -- check `wc -l`/`wc -c` against the roll rule before appending, and roll if needed per the header's own procedure). Get the timestamp from the clock, never memory. Summarize what shipped: Letflow.Api.Pagination (cursor encode/decode, prefix/expiry validation, page-size validation, PageResponse), all six ACs independently verified, INV-1 structurally enforced (Cursor has exactly one field), one adjacent MAJOR finding forwarded not fixed (ISS-0217, a test_parallel.sh/TenantSchemaReaper guard interaction, unrelated to this module).
3. Update `docs/status/requirement_status.index.yaml`'s current volume's `entries:` count in the SAME commit as the append.
4. `README.md`: check whether this change altered documented current behavior -- REQ-067 adds an internal API module with no externally-visible HTTP surface yet (no route wired up until REQ-072-onward), so likely NO README update is needed; confirm this explicitly rather than silently skipping.
5. No `docs/migration/stage-N-*.md` or `docs/migration/decisions/*.md` file was named by REQ-067's own acceptance criteria -- confirm this and state so explicitly (this is what makes step 4 of WF-02's own Step 6 procedure N/A here).
6. Complete the handoff: `artifacts_out` lists every file actually touched, named explicitly.

Get timestamps from the clock in their own command, never batched with the write that consumes them, and never from memory. Complete your work synchronously within this turn per `core-directives.md`'s rule.
acceptance_criteria: docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-067 entry reads status: done
A done event is appended to the current run-history volume (never rewriting a prior entry), with a real clock-read timestamp and a summary of what shipped including the forwarded ISS-0217 note
The current volume's entries: count in requirement_status.index.yaml is incremented in the same commit as the append
README.md is explicitly confirmed to need no update (no externally-visible behavior change yet), or updated if it does
The absence of a named stage/decision-record file in REQ-067's acceptance criteria is confirmed explicitly
artifacts_out lists every file actually touched, named explicitly
